column2: How do you split a register, track progress and share the status of a collection?
column3: “🗂 Status” tab of a collection. Splitting the work: “☑ Choose pages” → “👥 Assign to…” (a first name; empty = nobody), then “Pages for: …” shows each person’s pages (or those not assigned yet); on a page, “👥 Assigned to” and “✎ Assign…”. Progress: the app records one point per day the collection is opened, and the “📈 Progress” block draws the curve (transcribed, checked or finished) and says “at the current pace, finished around …”; you set a goal in “✎ Numbering, expected pages” (“🎯 all checked by …”): the app tells you whether you are ahead or behind. “🌍 Shareable page” saves a single HTML file (the identity card, the page-by-page status, the contents you can open and close, what’s in it) that opens in any browser, with no program needed. In the fonds view, “⤓ EAD” saves the finding aid in the archives’ format (EAD): services, fonds, collections with reference, dates, public access, licence, and their contents.
